notes: This catalog defines what the site should calculate/display; it does not certify any year's date or time.
Primary practical reference for OurHinduDharm is the owner's Ganesh Martand Panchang. Record edition/year/page and the rule it applies when the owner checks a hard copy.
Use local sunrise, sunset, tithi transitions, Bhadra intervals and solar ingress instants from the same location/timezone calculation provider. Never copy a prior year's clock time.
Keep calculated astronomical intervals, ritual decision rules, and editorial display text separate.

displayContract.location: Use selected Panchang location; show city and IST offset.
displayContract.date: Show the local civil date selected by the rule; support midnight rollover.
displayContract.time: Show local start–end times and the interval label (Pradosh, Nishita, Punyakaal, etc.) only when the rule and required input are verified.
displayContract.explanation: Add a concise 'निर्णय का आधार' note; distinguish calculated candidates from a reference-Panchang-approved observance.
displayContract.fallback: If inputs or rule are missing/conflicting, show 'मुहूर्त की गणना/सत्यापन शेष'; never invent a time.

rules.title: मासिक कालाष्टमी व्रत-तिथि
rules.dateDecision: Select the local civil date on which Krishna Ashtami is present during the Pradosh interval. If more than one date in the same Ashtami interval qualifies, prefer the earlier date for this monthly observance. If neither Pradosh interval qualifies, fall back to the earliest date with Krishna Ashtami at local sunrise. Pradosh is operationally sampled from local sunset through 144 minutes after sunset.

timeSlots.name: प्रदोषकाल
timeSlots.endRule: local sunset + 144 minutes; intersect with Krishna Ashtami

referenceChecks: Confirm the monthly night/Pradosh rule wording against the relevant printed Dharmasindhu passage and Ganesh Martand Panchang edge cases.
Test skipped, short, and two-Pradosh Ashtami intervals before production.

rules.title: वार्षिक कालभैरवाष्टमी / भैरवजयन्ती
rules.dateDecision: Apply the distinct Dharmasindhu Ashtami Nirnaya: if the first date has only Pradosh-vyapti and the second has Madhyahna-vyapti without Pradosh, choose the first; if Madhyahna-vyapti occurs on both dates choose the first; if it occurs on only one date choose that date; otherwise if Pradosh-vyapti occurs on both dates choose the second; if only one date has Pradosh-vyapti choose it; fallback to the earliest date with Krishna Ashtami at local sunrise.

timeSlots.name: मध्यान्ह-व्याप्ति
timeSlots.startRule: local daylight interval from 2/5 to 3/5 of sunrise-to-sunset duration
timeSlots.endRule: local daylight interval from 2/5 to 3/5 of sunrise-to-sunset duration

rules.primaryReference: Dharmasindhu, Ashtami Nirnaya; Kaustubha Pradosh-vyapti alternative quoted in the same passage
referenceChecks: Verify the precise Madhyahna and Pradosh interval definitions against the printed source/paddhati.
Test years where both dates satisfy both periods, one period only, or neither period.

rules.title: मासिक पूर्णिमा व्रत
rules.dateDecision: Use the local Panchang's vrat/observance day after testing tithi at sunrise and any applicable tradition-specific rule; do not choose solely from a civil date.
referenceChecks: Ganesh Martand Panchang: compare monthly Purnima vrat dates across a full year
Document any full-day, sunrise, or regional rule used for edge cases

timeSlots.name: प्रदोषकाल / धनतेरस पूजन
timeSlots.startRule: verified local Pradosh interval intersected with applicable Trayodashi

requiredInputs: verified Pradosh and observance decision rule
referenceChecks: Ganesh Martand Panchang: date and printed puja-muhurat interval

rules.title: दीपावली / महालक्ष्मी पूजन मुहूर्त

timeSlots.name: प्रदोषकाल लक्ष्मीपूजन
timeSlots.startRule: derive from local sunset and the verified tradition-specific Pradosh rule

timeSlots.name: निशीथकाल (यदि लागू)
timeSlots.startRule: derive from local night interval using the verified Nishita rule

requiredInputs: local sunset and next sunrise/night duration
referenceChecks: Ganesh Martand Panchang: chosen date and exact printed Lakshmi-puja slot
Compare alternate dates where Amavasya spans Pradosh/Nishita; record why one is selected

rules.title: होलाष्टक अवधि
requiredInputs: local Panchang day list spanning both boundary tithis
referenceChecks: Ganesh Martand Panchang: first and last day

rules.title: होलिका-दहन मुहूर्त

timeSlots.name: भद्रा-रहित होलिका-दहन
timeSlots.startRule: select the permitted local interval after applying the verified Purnima/Pradosh and Bhadra rule
timeSlots.endRule: permitted interval end after Bhadra considerations

requiredInputs: Bhadra start/end and any verified mukha/puccha rule
safetyRules: Do not infer the muhurat from the festival date alone.
If the applicable rule does not permit the usual interval, show the documented alternative rule and source; never silently choose a time.
referenceChecks: Ganesh Martand Panchang: exact Holika Dahan interval and Bhadra note
Primary source/paddhati supporting the selected Bhadra decision

rules.title: सभी 12 संक्रान्तियाँ और पुण्यकाल

timeSlots.name: संक्रान्ति क्षण
timeSlots.startRule: astronomically solve the exact sidereal ingress instant

timeSlots.name: पुण्यकाल
timeSlots.startRule: derive from ingress instant using the separately verified Sankranti-specific shastric rule; apply local sunrise/sunset/day-boundary conditions where prescribed
timeSlots.endRule: same verified rule's calculated end boundary

requiredInputs: exact sidereal solar ingress instant from one consistent ephemeris/ayanamsha
the relevant Sankranti's verified punya-kaal formula and restrictions
safetyRules: Do not apply one guessed fixed offset to every Sankranti.
Keep ingress time separate from Punyakaal start/end.
Makar Sankranti and other special cases may have distinct rules; document each exception.
If ingress is outside the applicable day/period, use only a verified textual rule to determine the next valid interval.
referenceChecks: Ganesh Martand Panchang: all 12 dates and printed Punyakaal
Primary Muhurta/Dharma-nibandha sources for general rule and named exceptions
